title: the MotP Plane of Elemental Earth
audit_comment: the Plane of Elemental Earth, printed pp. 41-46, the whole chapter: the least-hospitable doctrine (the solid wall - air, water and fire part but earth does not), the four border gradations (Magma, Ooze, Minerals, Dust), the 1d2-per-turn pressure, no atmosphere outside pockets, blind but 6-inch hearing through stone, the Strength 15/18/19/23 brute-force ladder at one foot per turn, the 1-in-10-per-four-hours check, the d12 phenomena (the d10 earthquake severity tiers 4d6/6d6/8d6, the inhabited fault lines, the 60/40 gas pockets, the mineral veins, the fossils with the 31-90 human band and the 20% mineralization), the d20 pocket table with the 80% air pockets, the native passwall and AC-2 mimic rules, the magic range rule, and the features (Ogremoch's vacuum-mesa citadel, Grumbar the mountain-juggernaut, the dao mazeworks and the Great Dismal Delve, the silver doorways and angular bubbles).

consts.name: dcyEarthPressureDie
consts.comment: the plane of Earth is the least hospitable of the four majors: the surrounding rock inflicts 1d2 points of damage per turn on the traveler caught like a fly on gummed paper, unable to move or return to the Ethereal unaided.

consts.name: dcyEarthEncounterDenom
consts.comment: travelers in the plane of Earth have a 1-in-10 chance of an encounter every four hours; roll: 1-5 elemental phenomena, 6-35 elemental pocket, 36-00 creature encounter.

consts.name: dcyEarthQuakeSeverityDie
consts.comment: the earthquake severity roll is d10: light (1-4) deals 4d6, medium (5-8) deals 6d6, severe (9-10) deals 8d6; a passing traveler saves vs. spell or is flung into the earth and trapped.

consts.name: dcyEarthGasPoisonPct
consts.comment: the volatile gas pocket: 60% poisonous (cloudkill in the pocket), 40% also explosive - open flame deals 8d8 fire damage to all within and 30% chance the walls weaken to a quake.

consts.name: dcyEarthFossilHumanPct
consts.comment: the fossil roll: 1-30 Prime Material creature, 31-90 human traveler (the largest share), 91-00 outer planar; 20% of fossils converted to precious minerals; human remains keep arms, armor and magic.

consts.name: dcyEarthStrengthSoft
consts.comment: the brute-force movement ladder (d10): very soft rock needs Strength 15, soft 18, hard 19, impenetrable 23 or Power abilities - at one actual foot per turn; the DSG mining rules (p. 48) apply where there is room to swing tools.

consts.name: dcyEarthAirPocketOccPct
consts.comment: the air pocket: a dry, lightless cavern, 80% occupied - Earth creatures 30%, Air creatures 30%, other-planar wayfarers 40% - the habitable heart of the inhabited plane.

consts.name: dcyEarthHearingInches
consts.comment: the traveler in Earth rock is blind but hears through it: any movement within 6 inches is detectable, including the passage of ethereal or phased creatures through the stone.

bools.name: dcyEarthSolidWall
bools.comment: air, water and fire all part for the traveler, but elemental earth forms a solid wall: entry requires a pocket, a stone shape, a passwall, or shape change into an earth creature - the Border Ethereal is the default stance.

bools.name: dcyEarthBordersGrade
bools.comment: the border gradations: warming viscous rock toward Magma, wetter pliable stone toward Ooze, crystal and ore bands toward Minerals, drying crumbling soil toward Dust.

bools.name: dcyEarthNativePasswall
bools.comment: all Earth natives (and the Magma, Ooze, Minerals and Dust natives) have a permanent passwall ability through elemental earth, conferred on those in physical contact - they treat the plane as the Ethereal for movement; Prime mimics are AC 2 factors better than their counterparts.

bools.name: dcyEarthMagicRangeRule
bools.comment: the magic rule: blind casters can only use range-0 or self spells unless they can see through the rock; created items do not move the stone (a wall of iron looks like a vein of iron, created water drains into mud pockets).

bools.name: dcyEarthNativeEarthImmunity
bools.comment: Earth natives are immune to earth-modifying spells (earthquake, move earth, stone shape) anywhere on the inner planes; they hide as thieves of level equal to their hit dice.

bools.name: dcyEarthSilverDoorway
bools.comment: the spell effects: Prime conjurations appear as great silver doorways of four to six sides that charm the summoned type - a traveler passing through is treated as a conjured, possibly controlled, creature; contact other plane makes angular translucent bubbles.
